newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel gets stay in patent suit.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel gets stay in patent suit.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said late Thursday, after the market closed, that the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit has issued a stay on the preliminary injunction and recall of Tractech's EZ Locker differential which was issued by a lower California court.
Tractech is a division of one of Titan's subsidiaries.
The Court of Appeals' ruling stays the preliminary injunction which would have restrained Tractech from making, using or selling the EZ Locker product.
Titan sold the Tractech business to a private investment group on September 30, 1996.
A company spokesman was not available for further details about the lawsuit.
